title: Nautical!
description: Adds more uses for nautilus shells in what is (Hopefully) a vanilla friendly way!
body:
-**Echoing Shell**: Crafted with 1 Echo Shard and 1 Nautilus Shell, this is a 3 durability item that allows the player to echolocate ores nearby! (yes this works on netherite)

-**Crystalline Shell**: Crafted with 1 Amethyst Shard and 1 Nautilus Shell, this is a 1 durability item that allows the player to mobs ores nearby! (this works on players too!)

-**Bouy**: Crafted with 2 White Wool, 2 Red Wool, and 1 String, this is a decoration block that can be mounted on walls, floors and ceilings!

-**Nautilus Shell Block**: Crafted with 4 Nautilus Shells, this is a storage/decoration block to give more use for nautilus shells!

-**Nautilus Shell Tiles** (With Stairs and Slabs): Crafted with 2 Prismarine shards and 2 Nautilus Shells, this is another decoration block for more nautilus shell uses!

-**Nautilus Shell Horn Functionality**: By default, nautilus shells can be played like a copper horn, with the direction the player is facing creating a different pitch!
